description: Convert a letter or percentage into the matching letter, percentage range and grade points on a grade scale. Inputs: grade (a letter like "B+" or a percentage like 87 or "87%") and a scale id. Example prompt: "Convert 78 percent to a letter grade on the Ontario college scale."

grade.description: A letter like "B+" or a percentage like 87 or "87%".

scale.description: Grade scale id: "us4", "us4plus", "ontario-college", "uk-classification", "australia-hd" or "weighted-5.0". Defaults to "us4". Ask the student which one their school uses if unsure.

name: convert_grade

letter.description: The letter the grade matches on the scale.

max_percent.description: The highest percentage the letter covers.

min_percent.description: The lowest percentage the letter covers.

points.description: Grade points the letter is worth on the scale.

scale.description: The scale id the grade was converted on.

scale_name.description: The name of the scale the grade was converted on.

title: Convert a grade
